features.name: debrief
features.title: debrief — answer agent questions from receipts (bench · run · eval · propose)
features.description: MCP server over three evidence ports: bench (what ggufbench measured, from its artifacts), run (where a buildwright run broke, from its log) and eval (what fleet-eval measured: delivery fidelity per dispatch-role task), plus routing.propose, which composes bench and run findings into a BW_ROLE_* diff returned as text. debrief never writes (ADR-0001); proposals target roles, never the models.yaml registry (ADR-0003); incomparable rows are refused, not averaged (ADR-0004); the ports answer independently and share one Finding type (ADR-0002). User-facing and demoable end-to-end per increment, so it is cut into vertical slices (docs/slicing-protocol.md): S1 bench_query, S2 run_inspect, S3 role_propose, S4 eval_query. The slice map in docs/architecture.md is approved at this parent's Spec Gate, and each slice becomes a feature with part_of: debrief.
acceptance: The parent is done only when its last slice (S4 eval_query) passes its Completion Gate with a recorded demo
Every tool response is findings or a structured error; no tool writes any file at any point
A slice's answers come only from its own source: bench from ggufbench artifacts, run from a buildwright run log, eval from fleet-eval results
harness/init.sh, uv run pytest tests, ruff, mypy --strict, audit-security and the gauntlet are green before each slice's Completion Gate
The final system is installable (uv sync / uv tool install) and each slice has a demo note in its approval record

features.name: debrief_bench_query
features.title: debrief S1 bench_query — agent asks what ggufbench measured -> findings from real artifacts
features.description: Walking skeleton (S1): bench.query reads real ggufbench artifacts through the BenchStore port and answers findings; gated inside the parent debrief.
acceptance: Bench findings come only from ggufbench artifacts (R3).
Every bench.query response is findings or a structured error (R1).

features.name: debrief_run_inspect
features.title: debrief S2 run_inspect — agent asks where a run broke -> structured findings
features.description: S2: run.inspect reads one buildwright run log through the RunLog port and answers findings; gated inside the parent debrief.
acceptance: Run findings come only from a buildwright run log (R4).
Every run.inspect response is findings or a structured error (R1).

features.name: debrief_role_propose
features.title: debrief S3 role_propose — agent gets a BW_ROLE_* proposal citing both ports, text only
features.description: S3: routing.propose composes QueryBench + InspectRun and renders a BW_ROLE_* diff as text; refuses incomparable rows; gated inside the parent debrief.
acceptance: The proposal is a BW_ROLE_* diff as text from both ports' findings (R5).
Proposals target BW_ROLE_* roles, never models.yaml (R6).
Incomparable rows answer a structured error, never an average (R7).

features.name: debrief_eval_query
features.title: debrief S4 eval_query — agent asks what fleet-eval measured, findings only
features.description: S4: eval.query answers from fleet-eval results through a new EvalStore port (answers/<model>/grade*.json), with its own task signature (battery digest + engine family) and delivery failures reported as failures; read-only, gated inside the parent debrief.
acceptance: Findings come only from fleet-eval results inside DEBRIEF_EVAL_ROOT (R12).
Every finding carries a task signature; cross-signature rows are refused, never averaged (R13).
A delivery failure is reported as fail and never reinterpreted as capability (R14).
The tool writes nothing; responses are findings or a structured error (R1, R2).
